author: Polar_Express
body:
Here is my latest Map. I hope you like.
  • Updated ( 2/16/2015 ) Map with YML: https://www.dropbox.com/s/soij4l9273iss0c/piratescove.zip?dl=0
  • Pics : http://imgur.com/a/q85y4

This is a tribute to Blue Cove. The pics only show about 30% of the detail of the map and all that can be done.
  • Each Quad has 2 shipwrecks to explore
  • Multiple mini mines
  • Multiple Secret areas to find and explore
  • No Op items.  No one will be able to get full diamond from their quad. -
  • No OP ore amounts, you will not find 15 iron in a vein.
  • Many Chests and a few named items to find.
This map also has many Outside of Quad locations to Explore:
  • 4 Ships - one supporting each team color
  • 4 "Crows" nest to defend
  • 2 Mine fields - got to have explosions when at a Pirates Cove
  • Lots of non-wet PVP areas including a Massive spiraling Mountain.

If you need more Pics please let me know, DL the map and give it a look.
Thanks
